gunman-firearms-expert-passive.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-firearms-expert-passive.scope: Full stock rifle-profile unload removed Firearms Expert bonuses. Ordinary reload restored the source-specific +5 ballistic accuracy and +5 ballistic damage sub-rows.

gunman-dual-handguns-passive.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-dual-handguns-passive.scope: After the acknowledged handgun unload sequence, Melee Resistance Bonus fell by 6 and Ballistic Accuracy Bonus fell by 5 while Soldier Upgrade and Firearms Expert stayed in place. The other aggregate damage and initiative changes were shared with other handgun entries.

gunman-expert-rifleman-passive.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-expert-rifleman-passive.scope: Stock Expert Rifleman reload produced +5 ballistic accuracy, +1 ballistic damage and +2 root duration. Its granted stock Action 1074 activated and replaced 1061, greyed out after unloading, then returned on reload.

gunman-rifle-mastery-passive.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-rifle-mastery-passive.scope: Stock Rifle Mastery added source-attributed +20 ballistic damage resistance, +10% stun duration and +15% root duration. The full ordinary unload removed its bonuses, and reloading restored the rifle profile.

gunman-sniper-passive.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-sniper-passive.scope: Stock Sniper produced +2 ballistic accuracy and damage sub-rows, removed during full unload and restored by ordinary reload. The 1136 Action was present, greyed out after unloading, and returned on reload.

gunman-soldier-upgrade.head: 0f1dd5323c81a0ed4320f8faed1ddfbfe1cc3266
gunman-soldier-upgrade.scope: Stock Soldier Upgrade activated from Actions in view 0 and showed self-only +50 max HP and +20 each melee and ballistic resistance. Immediate recast was refused during reuse, and stock 1074 removed it through ordinary class replacement.
